k.description:
The number of results to return from the similarity search.
Default is 5 if not specified.

metadataPaths.description:
The name of the fields/paths of the stored object that should be considered
metadata and therefore returned as part of {@link GenaiCore.VectorStore#similaritySearch}.
Specify an empty list if no metadata should be returned.

metadataFilter.description:
Filter to apply to {@link GenaiCore.VectorStore#similaritySearch}. Depending on the vector store,
this may be implemented as pre- or post-filtering.
In addition, for vector stores that support pre-filtering, the filter may need
to be specified in the specific format required by the vector store.
Consult the specific doc on your vector store type for specific details.

title:
